verification_rule: Metadata checked against the linked publisher, proceedings, government, or arXiv record; status is not inferred from a preprint alone.

entries.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Shielding
entries.relevance: Formal action shielding outside a learning component.
entries.claim_limit: Shielding assumes a safety specification and environment abstraction; it is not an evaluation of cross-layer guardrail faults.

entries.title: Conformal Risk Control
entries.relevance: Finite-sample control of expected monotone losses.
entries.claim_limit: Its statistical guarantees do not establish runtime authorization or effect correctness.

entries.title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
entries.relevance: Dynamic tool-agent security benchmark with attack and utility tasks.
entries.claim_limit: It evaluates prompt injection defenses, not failures spanning authorization through observed infrastructure effects.

entries.title: The Task Shield: Enforcing Task Alignment to Defend Against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
entries.relevance: Test-time alignment checking of instructions and tool calls.
entries.claim_limit: Task alignment is a model-mediated defense and does not independently verify environmental effects.

entries.title: AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
entries.relevance: A declarative runtime-constraint language across agent domains.
entries.claim_limit: Cite as a preprint unless a final venue is independently verified.

entries.title: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design
entries.relevance: CaMeL separates trusted control flow from untrusted data and uses capabilities.
entries.claim_limit: Cite as a preprint; its design guarantee is not evidence of cross-layer fault coverage.

entries.title: Securing AI Agents with Information-Flow Control
entries.relevance: Formal information-flow model and deterministic enforcement in Fides.
entries.claim_limit: Cite as a preprint and distinguish planner security from effect-grounded system evaluation.

entries.title: Policy Compiler for Secure Agentic Systems
entries.relevance: Dependency-graph policy compilation and deterministic reference monitoring.
entries.claim_limit: Cite as a preprint; reported policy compliance is not an independent environment-effect oracle.

entries.title: Before the Tool Call: Deterministic Pre-Action Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents
entries.relevance: Per-tool-call authorization and signed audit records.
entries.claim_limit: Cite as a preprint and do not generalize its bounty-test result beyond the reported policy and population.

entries.title: TraceSafe: A Systematic Assessment of LLM Guardrails on Multi-Step Tool-Calling Trajectories
entries.relevance: Mid-trajectory guardrail benchmark over structured tool traces.
entries.claim_limit: Cite as a preprint; its primary outcome is guardrail judgment rather than observed external effects.

entries.title: ToolSafe: Enhancing Tool Invocation Safety of LLM-based Agents via Proactive Step-level Guardrail and Feedback
entries.relevance: Proactive step-level tool invocation guardrail and feedback benchmark.
entries.claim_limit: Its learned safety judgment is distinct from deterministic policy enforcement and effect observation.

entries.title: ToolGate: Contract-Grounded and Verified Tool Execution for LLMs
entries.relevance: Hoare-style preconditions and verified postconditions for tool execution.
entries.claim_limit: Closest contract-level prior art; SENTINEL must claim fault-injection evaluation of the assurance chain, not tool contracts.

entries.title: The Simplex Architecture for Safe Online Control System Upgrades
entries.relevance: Foundational separation of an advanced controller and safety controller.
entries.claim_limit: The architecture is prior art; SENTINEL does not claim the separation pattern.

entries.title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
entries.relevance: Risk-coverage and abstention trade-offs for predictive systems.
entries.claim_limit: Selective prediction does not provide authorization or execution containment.

entries.title: AIOpsLab: A Holistic Framework to Evaluate AI Agents for Enabling Autonomous Clouds
entries.relevance: Interactive cloud-agent testbed with workload deployment and fault injection.
entries.claim_limit: AIOpsLab motivates the domain; SENTINEL must differentiate effect-grounded guardrail fault coverage.

entries.title: A Formal Verification Framework for Runtime Assurance
entries.relevance: Formal Simplex runtime-assurance framework supporting black-box learning components.
entries.claim_limit: Corrects the candidate bibliography title; formal construction and empirical fault coverage are different claims.

entries.title: Strengthening AI Agent Hijacking Evaluations
authors: NIST Center for AI Standards and Innovation Technical Staff
entries.relevance: Adaptive, repeated, and consequence-specific agent security evaluation guidance.
entries.claim_limit: Authoritative applied guidance, not a peer-reviewed research paper.
